sentences.text: On the Brightcart-Grocery test period, Bramblewood achieved a higher NDCG@10 than Larkspur-Seq (41.2% vs 40.7%), a mean paired difference of 0.5 percentage points that was statistically significant (paired t-test, p=0.0043, 95% CI [0.21, 0.85]).
Bramblewood also showed a higher Recall@20 than Larkspur-Seq (63.8% vs 63.1%), though no statistical test was reported for this metric.

Both neural models substantially outperformed the non-personalized Most-Popular baseline in NDCG@10 (41.2% and 40.7% vs 18.3%) and Recall@20 (63.8% and 63.1% vs 37.9%), indicating a large personalization benefit.
